rationale: The candidate papers provide substantive new evidence on the mechanisms regulating star formation quenching in various environments, including massive galaxies and clusters. Papers 2403.07742, 2504.10241, 2411.08155, 2604.20411, 2406.02664, and 2410.23896 all contribute to understanding different aspects of quenching processes, such as environmental effects, feedback mechanisms, and morphological transformations, but the question is not fully settled.
